description: Insurance Catastrophe Resilience Report, 2021-22 is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Insurance Council of Australia. This is the Insurance Council’s second annual Insurance Catastrophe Resilience Report, utilising the perspective, data and insights gained from the Insurance Catastrophes and Significant Events of the last 12 months to advocate for change that improves community resilience. Coverage is the states and territories; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: PDF (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies and resilience and disruption studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
